name: Realab Headphone Data Extractor
description: Extract frequency response / THD / noise cancelling curves from Realab.com headphone graphs, each series to its own CSV file.

data_collection_permissions.description: This extension does not collect any personal or usage data. It only extracts frequency response, THD, and noise cancelling data from Realab.com graphs for local processing and download. No data is transmitted to external servers.
